import sqlite3
import subprocess
import json
import urllib.request
ACCOUNTS_DATABASE_PATH = '/var/lib/app/accounts.db'
PROVISIONING_SCRIPT_PATH = '/opt/app/bin/apply_role_provisioning.sh'
AUDIT_SERVICE_URL = 'https://audit.internal.example.com/api/role-changes'

def promote_user_and_run_provisioning_job(user_id: int, role_name: str) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(ACCOUNTS_DATABASE_PATH)
    database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
    matching_role_row = database_cursor.execute('SELECT id FROM roles WHERE name = ?', (role_name,)).fetchone()
    if matching_role_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        raise ValueError(f'Unknown role: {role_name}')
    identifier_of_matching_role = matching_role_row[0]
    database_cursor.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) VALUES (?, ?)', (user_id, identifier_of_matching_role))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    audit_request = urllib.request.Request(
        AUDIT_SERVICE_URL,
        data=json.dumps({'user_id': user_id, 'role': role_name, 'action': 'grant'}).encode('utf-8'),
        headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        method='POST',
    )
    urllib.request.urlopen(audit_request, timeout=10)
    completed_provisioning_process = subprocess.run([PROVISIONING_SCRIPT_PATH, '--user-id', str(user_id), '--role', role_name], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    return {'user_id': user_id, 'role': role_name, 'provisioning_exit_code': completed_provisioning_process.returncode, 'provisioning_output': completed_provisioning_process.stdout.strip()}
